name: Claude Code Crash Course
headline: hands-on claude code crash course
short_description: Hands-on crash course for Claude Code with branch-based projects on MCP, subagents, hooks, and automation. For operations teams looking to streamline workflows and integrate AI-driven automation into their processes.
author: emarco177

sections.overview:
Claude Code Crash Course is a branch-based learning repository that teaches Claude Code, Anthropic's CLI for AI-powered software development, through practical projects. Each branch covers a specific feature—custom commands, MCP integration, context engineering, subagents, hooks, and notifications—with commits ordered chronologically for step-by-step learning. The course helps developers master code analysis, bug fixing, feature development, refactoring, and workflow automation directly from the terminal. It's designed for teams and developers wanting to integrate AI-driven automation into their development processes and operations workflows.
Learning MCP integration and Model Context Protocol setup
Building specialized AI subagents for specific development tasks
Automating workflows with hooks and event-driven notifications
Extending Claude Code with custom commands and functionality
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/emarco177/claude-code-crash-course`
sections.usage:
```
Create a hands-on crash course for [TEAM_NAME] to master Claude Code automation. Design a branch-based project that covers: 1) Setting up MCP servers for [SPECIFIC_USE_CASE], 2) Implementing subagents to handle [TASK_NAME] workflows, 3) Configuring Git hooks for automated pre-commit checks, and 4) Building a CI/CD pipeline for [DEPLOYMENT_TARGET]. Include step-by-step instructions, example commands, and troubleshooting tips. Assume the team has basic Python knowledge but no prior MCP experience. Provide a GitHub repository structure they can clone and modify for their own projects.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
